clue.text: Discharge from the army?

parts.note: reads like leaving military service, but the discharge is of weapons: soldiers shooting

explanation.surface: A soldier being released from service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Discharge' suggests being dismissed from the forces; here it is the firing of weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: Shooting by troops is literally a discharging of guns, so the army's discharge is its shots.

clue.text: In run, be a tenth on a winning streak?

indicators.note: the answer lies within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A batsman's tenth run keeps the winning streak alive.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit in rUN BE A TENth.
explanation.definitionFit: A team that has not lost is still on its run of wins.

clue.text: Lithe ibex fell badly

indicators.note: a bad fall jumbles things, so the letters of ibex fell are rearranged

explanation.surface: An agile wild goat takes a nasty tumble.
explanation.definitionFit: A supple, bendy body is lithe, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Delight following priest's manifestation of divine will

indicators.note: the joy comes after the cleric in the down entry

parts.note: Rev, Reverend, is the title of a priest
elation is delight

explanation.surface: A priest's joy follows a divine message.
explanation.definitionFit: Divine disclosure of truth or will to humans is revelation's theological sense.

clue.text: Second student leaving port has a dance

indicators.note: one letter departs from the port's name

parts.note: Hull is an English port city
the second of the two Ls, L being the learner or student

explanation.surface: A student leaves a harbour town to go dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: HULL is a port in Yorkshire, England. Remove its second L and add A.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hawaiian swaying dance is a well-known kind of dance.

clue.text: Joseph's with Hugh reportedly taking a book

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so the names are taken by their sound

parts.note: Joe's plus Hugh, said together, give the first two syllables

explanation.surface: Joseph and Hugh reportedly take out a book.
explanation.definitionFit: The sixth book of the Old Testament is named after Moses' successor.

clue.text: Select group's bed on lake

indicators.note: in a down entry the bed sits on top of the lake

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
Lake Erie is one of the Great Lakes

explanation.surface: An exclusive group lounges on a bed by a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A small exclusive clique is a coterie, a synonym.

clue.text: Estate needs me to move

indicators.note: the letters of needs me must shift around into a new order

explanation.surface: A property needs its owner to relocate.
explanation.definitionFit: A demesne is land attached to a manor, a landed estate.

clue.text: Ancient city zoo compound in east-north-east continental area

indicators.note: the city and the mixed zoo letters sit within the compass point

parts.note: ENE is the compass abbreviation
Ur was the ancient Sumerian city

indicators.note: to compound is to mix up, so the letters of zoo are combined afresh

explanation.surface: An old city's zoo complex sits in the far east of a continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'compound' looks like an enclosure for animals, fitting the zoo; it is the signal to mix those letters, which then go 'in' the compass point after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The block of European Union countries sharing the euro forms a region of the continent.

clue.text: Notice former pupil translated verse

parts.note: OB, old boy, is a former pupil of a school

indicators.note: translating changes the form of the word verse, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An old student spots a verse he once translated.
explanation.definitionFit: To notice something is to watch or perceive it, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Material wealth only?

parts.note: cash is money, wealth
mere means only, nothing more than

explanation.surface: Is material wealth all there is?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Material' looks like an adjective qualifying wealth; it is the noun, a fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: The fine wool from Kashmir goats is a fabric, so a material.

clue.text: Contest over Northern Territory is satisfactory

indicators.note: in a down entry the contest is placed above the territory

parts.note: to compete is to contest
NT abbreviates the Australian Northern Territory

explanation.surface: A dispute over the Northern Territory is resolved acceptably.
explanation.definitionFit: Adequate work is good enough, satisfactory.

clue.text: Artist settled back and spoke

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is a standard artist

indicators.note: going back means the word for settled is read from its end

parts.note: laid, as in laid to rest or put down

explanation.surface: A painter calmed down and then said something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns LAID into DIAL. 'spoke' looks like the past tense of speak; it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheel's spoke runs out from the hub, a line radiating from a centre.

clue.text: Poor maid helping will get approval

indicators.note: poor here means badly made, so the letters of maid are rearranged

parts.note: a ration is a helping or portion of food

explanation.surface: A struggling maid who lends a hand earns praise.
explanation.definitionFit: Admiring regard is warm approval, a near synonym.

clue.text: Signal can be assessed once more

parts.note: re- means again, once more
markable, able to be marked or graded

explanation.surface: A signal that can be checked again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Signal' looks like a noun or verb; it is the adjective meaning notable.
explanation.definitionFit: A signal achievement is striking and outstanding, an adjectival synonym.

clue.text: Bird leaves lake

parts.note: tea leaves, so leaves gives tea
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A bird flies away from a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' looks like a verb, but it is the noun: tea leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: This small freshwater duck is a kind of bird.

clue.text: Naturally it covers every one of us

definitions.text: Naturally it covers every one of us

parts.words: Naturally it covers every one of us
parts.note: sounds like a sweeping claim or insurance policy; in fact it is the outer layer of skin all humans have

explanation.surface: A boast that something applies to everybody without exception.
explanation.definitionFit: The outermost layer of skin covers each human body by nature.

clue.text: Sprats he cooked, being extremely hungry

indicators.note: cooked suggests ingredients mixed up, so the letters of sprats he are rearranged

explanation.surface: A ravenous man fries up some sprats.
explanation.definitionFit: An old term for ravenous: keen-edged with appetite.

clue.text: As a vehicle for verse

parts.note: qua is Latin for in the capacity of, as a
a train is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Something serving as a medium for poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: A four-line stanza is a unit of verse.

clue.text: Race son going to van

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
a camper is a camper van

explanation.surface: A son dashes to a van.
explanation.definitionFit: To scurry quickly is to race, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Show affection in a roundabout way?

definitions.text: Show affection in a roundabout way?

parts.words: Show affection in a roundabout way?
parts.note: roundabout suggests indirectly, but here it means with arms literally around someone

explanation.surface: Being affectionate indirectly.
explanation.definitionFit: Hugging puts one's arms round another person, affection shown literally around them.

clue.text: Net gain?

parts.note: looks like profit after costs, but it is a catch of fish brought in by a net

explanation.surface: A question about profit after expenses.
explanation.definitionFit: A fisherman's catch, drawn in by the net, is what the net gains.

clue.text: Order at all times to seize for military use

parts.note: a command is an order
e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, at all times

explanation.surface: A standing order to requisition things for the army.
explanation.definitionFit: Requisitioning property for the armed forces is exactly the verb's formal sense.

clue.text: For a short time, wonder about greeting Liberal

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the wonder wraps round the greeting and party letter

parts.note: awe is wonder
hi is a greeting

explanation.surface: Briefly marvelling at a greeting from a Liberal politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Briefly, for a little while, is the adverb's exact meaning.

clue.text: Katharine interrupted by a king in choppy exchange?

indicators.note: the name is broken into by the letters that follow, which sit inside it

parts.note: Kate is short for Katharine
R, rex, is king

explanation.surface: Katharine and a king have a rough-and-tumble argument.
explanation.walkthrough: A and R go inside KATE after its K. 'choppy' hints at karate chops.
explanation.definitionFit: A martial-arts bout is a trading of chopping blows, a jokey exchange.

clue.text: Trader's French sea song

parts.note: mer is French for sea
a chant is a song

explanation.surface: A trader sings a French sea shanty.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who buys and sells goods is a dealer, a synonym.

clue.text: Money? There's some in nanotechnology

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the long word are taken from within it

explanation.surface: Is there money in nanotechnology?
explanation.definitionFit: A banknote is paper money, so the answer is an example of money.

clue.text: Frightful villa by small houses

indicators.note: the phrase holds the answer within it as a house holds its occupants

explanation.surface: A dreadful villa sits beside small houses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'houses' looks like a noun but is the verb: the letters sit within villA BY SMALl.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dreadfully bad is appalling, an everyday synonym.

clue.text: Case modified after usual time to increase in intensity

indicators.note: modifying the word case changes its order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: late is after the usual time

explanation.surface: A case is altered and becomes more serious later on.
explanation.definitionFit: A conflict that grows more severe is said to step up, the verb's normal sense.

clue.text: Desmond Little's fate

parts.note: Des is short for Desmond
tiny means little; the possessive is just the surface

explanation.surface: The fate of a man called Desmond Little.
explanation.definitionFit: What is preordained to happen is one's lot, a direct synonym.
